issue.title: flag on the testclient to catch unhandle server exceptions

issue.body:
A Simple endpoint like:
```
async def view_raiser(request):
    assert 1 == 0
```
When I run under uvicorn, the exception logged on the console is:

```
ERROR: Exception in ASGI application
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/jordi/Documents/vinissimus/checkout/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/uvicorn/protocols/http/httptools_impl.py", line 368, in run_asgi
    result = await app(self.scope, self.receive, self.send)
  File "/home/jordi/Documents/vinissimus/checkout/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/uvicorn/middleware/asgi2.py", line 6, in __call__
    instance = self.app(scope)
TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not callable
INFO: ('127.0.0.1', 37596) - "GET /auth/raise HTTP/1.1" 500
```
Same happens with hypercorn.

I'm not pretty sure if this is the expected behaviour. At least on the wsgi world you found the full stack of the error on your server logs.
issue.title: Exceptions are not propagated to server error
flag on the testclient to catch unhandle server exceptions
